digest.component_or_area: CI/CD infrastructure — Ubuntu runner scheduling and test optimization
propositions: Ubuntu pytest jobs occupy 30+ runner-minutes per Verified run and contribute to queue contention despite macOS being the completion-path critical job.
Repeated YAML parsing in bridge cadence test's 1,440-minute comprehension consumes 5.7 runner-minutes per run without changing the exhaustive proof invariant.

Pandoc corpus and hardening suites execute full real conversion 3,421 times per run (884 units × 2 test files + legacy oracle) where one live product-code sample plus static legacy baseline preserves all assertion classes.
Editor fixture setup incurs 35s+ per Ubuntu cell without a covered defect but remains unexplained in isolation; socket.getfqdn measurement identifies the gating subcall.
Live Jira DC tests are already routed outside Verified via 'not external' selector and run in a dedicated weekly harness, so moving them saves zero Verified occupancy.

Six consensus-backed remediations (schedule hoist, existential short-circuit, immutable legacy oracle, AST index, complexity singleton, cancellation repair) preserve coverage while reducing end-to-end wall time below 30 minutes and Ubuntu occupancy by 21%.
